description: Search current flight deals from Luxembourg (default) or nearby airports. Returns return-trip prices in EUR with dates, the usual route price, a booking link and when the price was last checked.

destination.description: Destination IATA code, city or country, e.g. 'BCN', 'Barcelona' or 'Spain'
destination.title: Destination

include_expired.description: Include deals whose outbound date has passed
include_expired.title: Include Expired

limit.description: Max number of deals to return (1-25)
limit.title: Limit

month.description: Outbound month, YYYY-MM. Matches the cheapest outbound date only.
month.title: Month

origin.description: Departure airport IATA code, or 'any' for all 7
origin.title: Origin

name: search_deals

expires_at.description: Deal is no longer bookable after this date (outbound date)
expires_at.title: Expires At

id.description: Stable deal id (origin-destination-airline). Pass to get_deal.
id.title: Id

last_checked.description: When FlyScout last saw this price, ISO 8601
last_checked.title: Last Checked

other_cheap_dates.description: How many other cheap outbound dates exist
other_cheap_dates.title: Other Cheap Dates

outbound_fare_eur.description: Outbound one-way fare. Low-cost carriers only
outbound_fare_eur.title: Outbound Fare Eur

return_fare_eur.description: Return one-way fare. Low-cost carriers only
return_fare_eur.title: Return Fare Eur

usual_price_eur.description: Median return price on this route
usual_price_eur.title: Usual Price Eur

feed_stale.description: True if the daily scan is older than 36 hours
feed_stale.title: Feed Stale

title: Search flight deals
